question: Jeev Milkha Singh is associated with which sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Golf.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jeev Milkha Singh** is a professional golfer from **India who has won multiple international tournaments.
 
• He is the son of legendary Indian athlete** Milkha Singh, also **known as the** **"**Flying Sikh".**
 
• In **1998**, he became the **first Indian player **to compete on the **European Tour.**
 
• In **October 2006**, he became the first golfer from India to enter the **top 100** of the **Official World Golf Ranking.**
 
• In 2007, the Indian government bestowed upon him the **Padma Shri, a civilian honor.**
 
• Additionally, he received the **1999 Arjuna Award.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cricket** is primarily a **bat and ball** sport.

 
 
• It involves **batting, fielding, and bowling** and is played by **two teams** on an oval field.
 
• A game can last anywhere from several hours to several days, with **11 players **on each side.
 
 
 
• In the sport of **hockey, **two teams of **eleven players **each use a curved stick to attempt to shoot a small, hard ball into the opposing team's goal.
 
• **Running, jumping, throwing, and walking** competitions are all included in the sport of athletics.
